messages.author: 0a66b73ce1f986f6
messages.subject: An error has occurred. The application exited unexpectedly.  socket hang up
parts:
Hi all,
 I have set up an rstudio server and shiny server on ubuntu 16 and having troubles during download of ReporteRs files using the downloadbutton since today (after upgrading shiny-server and the shiny package itself).
 The error I can't get rid of is: "An error has occurred. The application exited unexpectedly.  socket hang up" and can be reproduced as follows.
 
goto: http://shiny.bsoh.be/co2sim/
login and password: test

on the tab "Simulate" press "Add to combined plot"
on the tab "Download" press "Download report"

An example of the app log is attached: "Listening on http://127.0.0.1:39639 
Loading required package: ReporteRsjars
R: fccache.c:534: FcCacheFini: Assertion `fcCacheChains[i] == NULL' failed.
-su: line 1:  3750 Aborted                 (core dumped) R --no-save --slave -f \/opt\/shiny-server\/R\/SockJSAdapter\.R"

 Deploying exactly the same app locally works fine with the same versions of R and the packages shiny, ReporteRs and ReporteRsjars.
 What could be the problem here? Download time too long? The shiny-server log itself shows no errors.
 Kind regards.
Tom.

messages.author: 8cd04449be479c53
messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred. The application exited unexpectedly. socket hang up
parts:
Tom, could you confirm that the crash is fixed after installing this branch:

  devtools::install_github("lionel-/gdtools@fix-fcfini")

Thanks,
Lionel
